overview:
This open-seat House race is rated Safe Democratic. The district's fundamentals lean strongly Democratic following redistricting, and no expert raters flag it as competitive. Ben McAdams holds a massive financial advantage, raising about $2.3 million with nearly $300,000 on hand, while Republican Riley Owen has raised only about $133,000 with under $10,000 available. Outside groups have spent $2.7 million supporting McAdams and nothing against him.

Prediction markets on Kalshi and Polymarket both price a Democratic win at roughly 94-95 percent. With no general-election polling available, the forecast rests on district fundamentals and the money gap, both of which point clearly one direction.
